claims.quote: Betta spilotogena is a mouthbrooding labyrinth fish from Bintan and Singkep islands in the Riau Islands province of Indonesia.
Described from a 'small stream' in the north of Bintan Island, Riau Archipelago, Indonesia and subsequently recorded from Singkep Island in the Lingga Islands Archipelago.
